title: Royal Bull's Head Inn
geometryBasis: The named OpenStreetMap footprint gives the street-side long edge, rectangular main block and short southwestern return. The street view in the old photo establishes the front verandah extent and dormer rhythm.
sectionBasis: Model uses the family photograph and State Library account for the pitched main roof, three vertically faced dormers, veranda, external chamferboard and timber frame.
limitations: The standing inn and its small rear kitchen return are represented. Detached former stables, ancillary structures and the demolished earlier inn are outside this source.
Roof pitch, paint colors, rear dormer and door placement, enclosure position and joinery detail are estimated from monochrome photographs and written records.
